column15:
Wishlisted one hoodie, but wasn't sure about the size and fabric quality. The reviews weren't that helpful, so had to go to an offline store just to see it. (The offline price was more, so didn't buy it 😅). 
All my doubts were clear after seeing it like which size to buy, and I was satisfied with the quality.
Got home, ready to place the order, and to my surprise, it was unavailable now 🤦🏻
Had to wait for a few days. It became available, so placed the order. But this time, the delivery partner didn't deliver it, and since there was no option to call the partner directly, the package was just roaming from one hub to another, which eventually resulted in the order being cancelled 🙂

Ultimately, didn't buy it the 2nd time either. It's still sitting on my wishlist 😂
column16: Can offer some discounts, or price drop alerts notifications for wishlisted products, even minor price difference could result more buying
